## What it is

The epic gathers every defect and guidance gap the operator raised during the 3.1.1 evaluation.

It runs from the present export frame sizing to the copy limits on generated pages.

Every fix lands on one integration line.

The release notes then describe the milestone as a whole.

The epic owns the capability pages and the status prototype.

Each landing gets a cross-lineage review.

The Visual and docs Coordinator holds the epic and routes each task.

The Director holds the milestone decision and the operator merges into main.

blocks.title: Owner
blocks.markdown: The Visual and docs Coordinator holds the epic and routes each task to a builder lane.
